classification: Terminal close/send/shell CLI dispatch and mixed-version receipt semantics
rationale: Retain all26 declarations and10 table rows. Reuse one checked RuntimeClient/status fixture across close, prompt and shell controls; correct the bulk-close refusal that previously failed during active-worktree lookup; inspect actual printed legacy receipt; require prevalidation silence and trim raw injected-object assertions while preserving observable failures and permission guidance.

cases.title: keeps the default close RPC unchanged
cases.reason: Default explicit-terminal close must dispatch terminal.close, print the successful killed receipt and leave the CLI exit code unset.

cases.title: reports an unverifiable stop (%s, kill recorded: %s) as a committed close with exit code 1
cases.reason: All three unregistered-provider/timeout-with-recorded-kill/timeout-on-older-host rows must print a failing JSON receipt with exact independent guidance and original close data, setting exit1.

parameter_inputs.expression:

cases.title: reports a live PTY stop as a failing human outcome
cases.reason: A live PTY verdict must produce the human live warning and exit1, despite a completed close RPC.

cases.title: routes --tab to the durable whole-tab RPC
cases.reason: Actual parsed --tab routes to terminal.closeTab and does not treat a legacy ptyKilled=false without a liveness verdict as a failing close.

cases.title: routes --worktree --all to authoritative durable bulk close
cases.reason: Parsed --worktree plus --all routes the concrete worktree identity to authoritative terminal.closeAll.

cases.title: fails JSON when bulk close cannot verify every PTY stopped
cases.reason: A bulk-close result that cannot verify all PTYs stopped must become terminal_stop_unverifiable JSON with counts/verdict and exit1.

cases.title: rejects ambiguous bulk-close flags
cases.reason: All three ambiguous/missing bulk flag rows retain specific rejection guidance and now explicitly require zero RPC calls before mutation.

cases.title: fails safely before mutation when the host predates bulk close
cases.reason: Use an explicit worktree identity so the mocked old-host refusal comes from terminal.closeAll itself, then require exactly that RPC/payload. The original active selector failed during worktree.list and did not exercise the intended method.

cases.title: documents that --tab waits for durable persistence
cases.reason: Actual printed close help retains bulk-close usage and the durable-persistence guidance for tab close.

cases.title: describes the server-selection flags in terminal %s help
cases.reason: All four send/read/wait/create help paths expose both paired-server environment and pairing-code guidance.

cases.title: hides legacy stop from terminal command discovery
cases.reason: Actual terminal group discovery must show close while hiding the legacy stop command.

cases.title: keeps root help aligned with the canonical close command
cases.reason: Root help must describe the canonical close behavior and omit the legacy stop command.

cases.title: marks combined text and Enter as an agent prompt candidate
cases.reason: Text plus Enter must dispatch an agentPrompt send with exact terminal/text/client fields and the attested runtime preflight option.

cases.title: carries the swallowed-Enter warning into the --json receipt
cases.reason: A supported accepted prompt whose stages stop at input_accepted must carry swallowed-Enter guidance into actual JSON output.

cases.title: reports an older host's lease refusal as a plain refused send
cases.reason: An older lease refusal remains a human refused-send outcome after capability preflight, setting exit1 without claiming accepted input.

cases.title: keeps text-only and bare Enter sends as direct terminal input
cases.reason: Both text-only and bare-Enter controls must issue distinct direct-input payloads without prompt delivery metadata.

cases.title: passes retry identity and observation wait only for agent prompts
cases.reason: An explicit retry ID and three-second observation wait must reach the prompt payload and runtime options with the correct request identity and13-second transport budget.

cases.title: fails closed when the host downgrades after the prompt capability preflight
cases.reason: Retain exact preflight/retry options, unknown delivery outcome, retrySafe=false, independent inspection guidance and no printed receipt after host downgrade; fold the unchecked Error cast into the existing error match and drop redundant absence on the injected fixture.

cases.title: labels an old-host response as non-idempotent without claiming submission
cases.reason: Keep legacy prompt dispatch options but assert the independently written unsupported-old-host receipt in printed JSON rather than reading the mutable mocked response. A mutation removing only the printed prompt passes the original and fails this reviewed case.

cases.title: does not fabricate an accepted prompt receipt for an old-host refusal
cases.reason: Preserve the old-host accepted=false and permission-reason inputs and exact human refusal output. Remove the raw mock-response absence check and name the observable permission outcome accurately.

cases.title: refuses old-host retry before sending any input
cases.reason: An old host must reject an explicit retry before input, retain the warning that an upgrade cannot make this prior attempt idempotent and never advise dropping the retry ID.

cases.title: preserves retry identity after a pre-write host failure
cases.reason: A pre-write failure followed by an explicit retry must preserve the same request ID and runtime preflight options across exactly two sends.

cases.title: sends the shell selection alongside an empty startup command
cases.reason: The shell-selection RPC must carry cmd.exe independently of the empty startup-command field.

cases.title: refuses a shell the host cannot spawn without making the round trip
cases.reason: Unsupported nu.exe must reject locally before any terminal-create RPC.

cases.title: refuses rather than creating a default-shell terminal on a host without the capability
cases.reason: A reachable older host lacking shell-selection capability must refuse before creating a terminal using the wrong default shell.

cases.title: reports an unreachable host as unavailable rather than incompatible
cases.reason: An unreachable host must report runtime_unavailable instead of treating absent capabilities as a version incompatibility, without creation.
